title: Generic check fixture
mdxx:
  format: 1
---

import { useState } from "react";

export function Counter() {
  const [count, setCount] = useState(0);
  return <section aria-labelledby="counter-heading">
    <h1 id="counter-heading">Interactive counter</h1>
    <button type="button" data-increment onClick={() => setCount(value => value + 1)}>Increment</button>
    <output data-count={count}>{count}</output>
  </section>;
}

<Counter />
